name: Fetch
description: Read a source. SPEC-MANIFEST.md §5.1. Fails on non-2xx, on a network error, and — for format: rss — on a feed with no items. An empty feed is not a success: the steps after it expect material. The RSS reader is regex-based, not an XML parser.

status.notes: HTTP status. Present on every format.

count.notes: format: rss — number of entries kept.

entries.notes: format: rss — each entry is {title, link, summary, published}.
